promptExact: Use case: product-mockup / engineering visual reference. Create one polished photoreal industrial reference sheet for a compact unbranded thrust ball bearing, using the supplied NVIDIA SimReady bearing image as an APPEARANCE REFERENCE for concentric steel rings, dark machined flange, and muted brass cage. This is an original plausible reconstruction for a Three.js animation, not a CAD measurement or an exact claim about hidden internals. Four clean views on one wide reference sheet: assembled three-quarter view; exact top view; side section showing race grooves and ball contacts; exploded axial view. The SAME coherent object in all four views: two thick precision-ground steel annular race washers, one thin brass annular separator cage with 18 equally spaced circular ball pockets, 18 polished steel balls captured in those pockets. Central bore stays open, groove radius and ball clearances are plausible, washers are matching diameters. Show the exploded components aligned on the same vertical shaft axis, no random extra pieces. Real brushed and ground steel, soft anisotropic highlights, restrained machining marks, warm brass, strong silhouette and subtle contact shadows. Plain charcoal studio background, broad softbox reflections, crisp high-end product photography. No logo, no brand, no text, no arrows, no dimensions, no watermark. This is a modeling reference asset; do not simulate the final animation or add graphic UI.
